job.title: Office Administrator
job.description:

Their Stapylton team supports the supply, storage and distribution of equipment, with an opportunity available for an experienced Office Administrator to support daily operations.

  • Monday to Friday, 6:30am–2:36pm - no weekends!

  • Ongoing opportunity with an ASAP start.

  • Training provided on company systems.

About the Role:

  • Maintain accurate inventory records and complete stock reconciliations.

  • Coordinate purchasing, including quotes, purchase orders and order follow-up.

  • Update Excel registers, trackers and internal systems.

  • Complete data entry and maintain accurate records and documentation.

  • Liaise with yard staff, transport personnel and suppliers.

  • Support the administration team and coordinate daily administrative tasks.

About You:

  • Previous administration experience within construction, transport, warehousing or a similar industrial environment.

  • Intermediate or higher Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Ability to prioritise tasks, meet deadlines and work independently.

job.title: In Store Florist
job.description:
Our client, a market leader in wholesale floral and potted products, priding themselves on product quality and customer service are seeking to recruit Floral Wrappers/florists with previous experience or training to join our team on a casual basis 5-6 days per week.

We are looking for an enthusiastic individual to work within a retail space who will ensure the highest quality customer service, floral ranges and flower arrangements are provided for the store’s customers. Recent graduates of floristry training encouraged to apply.

Located in Brisbane CBD, duties will include:


  • Wrapping of mixed and single floral bunches (small and large)
  • Bouquet arrangements to customer specification
  • Use of specialised gift-wrapping materials
  • Advising customers on floral selections
  • Merchandising the store to showcase designs and quality
  • Maintaining stock levels
  • Maintaining a safe, clean, and well-organised working and shopping environment and comply with all applicable health and safety procedures and safe work practices.

To be successful, candidates will have the following:


  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively unsupervised
  • Certificate 3 in Floristry or equivalent experience
  • Ability to follow instructions and procedures
  • Passion for floral retail
  • Creative flair
  • Effective time management skills
  • Strong work ethic
  • Ability to visually examine products for quality and freshness
  • Available to work shifts on Monday - Friday (potentially Saturdays), Start time approx. from 7:30am.
  • Expected hours roughly 30 hours/wk
  • Previous exposure to a retail environment would be advantageous

Applicants will be notified via email and phone if successful for interview selection. Please ensure your application has a current email address and mobile number.

job.title: Production Workers – Fresh Flowers Wholesale
job.description:
BLU by Adcorp is seeking reliable and enthusiastic production workers to join our client’s floral production team at Ingleburn.

Our client supplies fresh flowers and potted products to major supermarkets across Australia. You’ll help prepare, arrange and pack flower bouquets and floral products in a modern warehouse.

Full training is provided, with immediate starts available.

About the opportunity

We’re looking for dependable people who enjoy practical work, are keen to learn new skills and work well in a diverse team.

You must be available Monday to Friday and willing to work extended hours during busy periods.

Production duties may include:

  • Preparing flowers for production
  • Arranging bouquets and creating floral displays to design specifications
  • Wrapping mixed and single-variety flower bunches
  • Wiring flowers for specialised designs
  • Using specialised gift-wrapping materials
  • Labelling and packing finished products

Dispatch and receivals duties may include:

  • Packing products for dispatch
  • Stacking and preparing pallets
  • Moving products using manual pallet jacks
  • Operating forklifts, where required—applicants undertaking forklift duties must hold a current forklift licence

What you’ll bring

  • Reliability and a strong work ethic
  • A willingness to learn and follow instructions
  • Attention to detail and pride in your work
  • The ability to work cooperatively in a busy team environment
  • Availability Monday to Friday, with flexibility for additional hours during peak periods

Apply now

If this sounds like you, submit your current resume outlining your availability and any relevant experience.

Shortlisted applicants will be contacted by email and/or SMS to arrange an interview or site induction. Please ensure your resume includes your current mobile number and email address.
